units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:13">Cant. R. to VIII, 13</cite> <he>אני</he> … <he>מַקְשִׁיבִים וכ׳</he> I and my household will listen to thy voice (of prayer).
<cite ref="Shabbat 63a:19">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>הקב״ה מַקְשִׁיב להם</he> the Lord listens to them.
Ib. שני … המקשיבים זה לזה וכ׳ two students who patiently listen to each other in discussions of the halakhah; a. e.
